findings.text: To date ai.pattern_mood.sonnet.v1 leads on return per trade: 51 trades, 25 wins, net +11204.34 INR (0.22%), versus base.always_up.v1 at 0.02% over 576 trades. This week it held near flat (-153.68 INR over 38 trades) while always_up lost -137296.95 INR. A short record with no luck test in these inputs: not proof of skill.

ai.pattern_mood.sonnet.v1 gained when sector or news lifted its five-session holds (M&M, ONGC) and lost on one-session picks in a falling market (M&M, HINDALCO). Trading costs turned a near-flat TATASTEEL hold into a loss. Its edge so far looks like riding sector moves, not stock picking.

News-led strategies trail: ai.news_results.sonnet.v1 has 7 trades, 1 win, -9172.9 INR (-1.31%); rule.model_news_double.v1 has 12 trades, 3 wins, -8312.48 INR (-0.69%). Their settled losses came mostly from market or company moves (ICICIBANK, RELIANCE), not news. No other rule strategy appears in the leaders lists. Far too few trades to judge.

An IT sector rally drove the week's biggest moves. The TCS news item behind part of it is a confirmed_primary M&A story rated low materiality, a single event, so no evidence. Three TCS down calls resting on a small dividend all missed, with actual returns 0.181687, 0.126322 and 0.172516, each closing above the wider published band.

Among rows with enough events, unverified and single-source earnings items moved most: unverified high-materiality -2.1009% abnormal at N+2 (interval -2.9402 to -1.2616, 20 events); single-source medium +2.4844% at N+5 (43 events, sector mean +10.6408%). Every confirmed_primary and corroborated earnings row lacks enough events. One week, overlapping windows, a sector rally: not yet evidence.

Some news-impact rows list one news id twice, as in the unverified high earnings row, likely one item tagged to two companies; if such events are not independent, the intervals are too narrow. Nearly every settled trade is also flagged target reached in session one, losers included (M&M), so that flag tells little.
